evals.prompt: Dobierz pompę obiegową c.o. dla obiegu grzejnikowego 120 kW, 70/50, najdłuższy obieg ok. 120 m rury DN50.
evals.expected_output: Uses hvac_calc.py water-flow (about 5.25 m3/h) and pipe-dp. Asks for or states assumptions for the heat source, control valve, terminal and meter pressure drops. Applies one margin with reason. Does not invent a pump model; gives a specification or asks for data sheets. Includes ecodesign EEI requirement with EUR-Lex source. Output in Polish in the selection sheet format.

evals.prompt: I need an AHU for an open-plan office: 2400 m3/h supply and extract, rotary heat recovery, ESP 250 Pa each side. Check what SFP I can expect and what else you need from me.
evals.expected_output: Asks for missing inputs from the AHU checklist (location, filter classes, coils, design outdoor conditions, acoustic limits). Uses fan-power with stated assumed efficiency and explains SFP vs SFPint (Regulation 1253/2014). Does not claim compliance without manufacturer SFPint. Lists items to verify.

evals.prompt: Select a pump for 8 m3/h at 12 m head, 30% propylene glycol, 7/12 C chilled water.
evals.expected_output: Notes glycol is not in the water table and asks for or cites glycol data (density, viscosity, cp) from a manufacturer; uses --rho/--cp/--mu-mpas overrides. Warns about glycol effect on coils and head. Does not stack margins. Gives alternatives and a verification list.
